review_summary: The production change reads SOURCE and XSA SHA values from checked["build"], which validate_v1_inputs populates from transport.verify_build after verifying the config build_details path/SHA binding. Config now remains a path/SHA binding, matching the real input shape.

The new regression uses the actual R04 build_details record and asserts the emitted banner receives its source and XSA hashes. The shared execute_board_flow fixture also now models binding-only build_details plus a separately verified checked build record.
The correction is limited to the reported KeyError path and its fixture/regression; no G0, preparation, board scheduler, or platform closure changes were included in this delta.
acceptance_limitations: PASS covers only this runner/test delta. It does not establish that the new formal R02 hardware deployment, UART acceptance, 109 corpus, 1000 repeat, G3/G4/G5 passed.
